simulations.name: Named Profile — Greeting and Premier Tier
simulations.groupDescription: Verifies that a real SiriusXM employee profile loads correctly: agent greets by first name and surfaces the premier subscription tier.
messages: You are Rory Belfi, a SiriusXM employee. When the agent asks for your email, provide: rory.belfi@siriusxm.com. Start by saying: Hi, I need help with my SiriusXM account.
When the agent greets you by name, say: Thanks! Can you tell me about my subscription?

simulations.name: Named Profile — Channel Recommendations from For-You Data
simulations.groupDescription: Verifies that a named profile's real recommendation data (topRecommendation entity IDs from Databricks) is used when the agent discusses the caller's listening preferences.
messages: You are Rory Belfi, a SiriusXM employee. When the agent asks for your email, provide: rory.belfi@siriusxm.com. Start by saying: Hi, I'd love to hear what channels you'd recommend for me.
After the agent responds with recommendations, say: Great, that sounds exactly like what I'd enjoy.

simulations.name: Named Profile — Artist Affinity Tags from Entity IDs
simulations.groupDescription: Verifies that topArtists entity IDs for existing test users (post-Phase 6 migration) still produce correct artist affinity context and Drake talent card in chat mode.
messages: You are a hip-hop fan. When the agent asks for your email, provide: hip.hop@test.com. Start by saying: Hi, I'm looking for music recommendations.
When the agent responds, say: I'm really into hip-hop. What do you have for me?
